unit_rules.name: The Regent
unit_rules.text:
At the start of the Battle Round, do one of the following:
* Add 1 to the OC of friendly units within 6" until the end of the Battle Round
* Target an enemy unit within 24" with the "Second Vow" strategem for 0 CP.
* Target a friendly unit within 12" with a Strategem for 0 CP

unit_rules.name: Bodyguards of the Regent
unit_rules.text: While within 3" of a friendly +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ unit and not a +Leader+ or +Support+, this model has +Lone Operative+.
